All other elementary moves are legal'; 2023: 'the move of an alphanumeric figurative constant (SPACE, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, ALL "literal", ...) to ... numeric ... is prohibited'. 1985 allowed QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE and ALL literal (alphanumeric) to be moved to numeric items. 2023 prohibits these, except ALL digits moved to an integer item.
